I re-solved the puzzle from scratch by checking each possible slot for Hana (2 through 7). Only Hana = 2, with Finn in slot 1, works, so the schedule is unique and matches my earlier answer.

All 17 constraints hold:
- Elif 3 < Ben 5, Hana 2 < Ann 8, Hana 2 < Ivo 9, Cara 6 < Gus 7, Elif 3 < Ivo 9, Cara 6 < Ivo 9, Dev 4 < Gus 7.
- Ann–Hana = 6, Ben–Ivo = 4, Ann–Ben = 3, Gus–Hana = 5, Dev–Ivo = 5, Dev–Finn = 3 (all at least 3 apart).
- Exactly one person between Dev (4) and Hana (2): Elif in slot 3.
- Exactly one person between Gus (7) and Ivo (9): Ann in slot 8.
- Exactly one person between Ben (5) and Elif (3): Dev in slot 4.
- Hana (2) is immediately after Finn (1).

The team note's version (Ann in 7, Gus in 8, Ivo in 9) doesn't work. Gus and Ivo would be adjacent, not separated by exactly one person, so it breaks the Gus–Ivo constraint.
